model: none - no image model was called and nothing was spent
post_process: one backing per cell, from that cell alone: threshold 64, close 0.012 of the cell edge, fill holes, drop islands under 0.0005 of the cell, no grow, feather 0.6px, black, lossless WebP
source: anim/float-eye/, each cell backed by the file of the same index. Holds only the silhouette: no pixel of colour survives.
license_note: Derived from float-eye.webp, an owner-supplied external illustration (no source traced). T, 2026-10-29, D115: "The images we use for everything are open source."
